cases.sentence: Не тяжкий ли труд уготовлен на земле ___?
cases.explain: The verb уготовлен (appointed) with the dative of the person to whom something is appointed requires the dative case.
The verb жаждет (longs for) requires the genitive case expressing what one desires.

cases.sentence: Как батрак, который ожидает ___, так и я получил месяцы суеты
cases.explain: The verb ожидает (waits for) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я ворочаюсь до зари, червями и язвами ___ одета
cases.explain: Кожа is the grammatical subject of the predicate adjective одета (clothed) and stands in the nominative case.
Дни (days) is the subject of the verb бегут (run) and stands in the nominative plural case.

cases.sentence: Вспомни, Боже, что жизнь моя лишь ___ ветра
cases.explain: Дуновение is a predicate nominative after the verb есть (is, implied) and stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Как редеет облако и исчезает, так не выйдет и тот, кто спускается в ___ мертвых
cases.explain: The verb спускается (descends) with the preposition в (into) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Разве я ___ или чудовище морское, что ты окружил меня стражей?
cases.explain: Море is the predicate nominative in this rhetorical question and stands in the nominative case.

reading.ru: Не тяжкий ли труд уготовлен на земле человеку, дни его, не дни ли батрака?
reading.question: What is Job comparing his days on earth to?
options: The days of a hired worker
reading.correct: The days of a hired worker
reading.explain: Job asks if man's days on earth are not like those of a hired hand, toiling for wages.

reading.ru: Ложась, размышляю, когда я встану, но тянется ночь, и я ворочаюсь до зари
reading.question: What is Job's experience at night?
options: He tosses and turns until dawn longing to rise
He sleeps peacefully through the night
He stands and watches the stars
reading.correct: He tosses and turns until dawn longing to rise
reading.explain: Job describes lying down, wondering when morning will come, but the night stretches on and he writhes until dawn.

reading.ru: Червями и язвами плоть одета, кожа потрескалась и гноится
reading.question: What condition is Job's body in?
options: Clothed with worms and sores, with skin cracked and festering
reading.correct: Clothed with worms and sores, with skin cracked and festering
reading.explain: Job describes his flesh as clothed with worms and sores, his skin cracked and oozing with pus.

reading.ru: Вспомни, Боже, что жизнь моя лишь дуновение
reading.question: How does Job describe his life?
reading.explain: Job asks God to remember that his life is but a breath — fleeting and temporary.

reading.ru: Как редеет облако и исчезает, так не выйдет и тот, кто спускается в мир мертвых
reading.question: What does Job say about those who descend to Sheol?
options: They do not return, like a cloud that fades away
They come back to the earth
They dwell in comfort and peace
reading.correct: They do not return, like a cloud that fades away
reading.explain: Job compares the irreversibility of death to a cloud that fades and is gone — those who descend to Sheol do not return.

reading.ru: Обращение Иова к Богу: Что такое человек, что ты так его возвеличил, что обращаешь на него внимание?
reading.question: In Job's address to God, what does he ask?
options: Why God magnifies humanity and pays such attention to mankind
reading.correct: Why God magnifies humanity and pays such attention to mankind
reading.explain: Job questions God about why He exalts man and pays such close attention to him, visiting him every morning.
